in_sanskrit.name: कमलाक्ष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One with eyes like a lotus flower

in_marathi.name: Kamalaksh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamalaksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words, Kamala (lotus) and Akshi (eyes), Kamalaksh symbolizes divine eyes of Lord Vishnu.

in_bengali.name: Kamalaksh
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamalaksh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two words, Kamala (lotus) and Akshi (eyes), Kamalaksh symbolizes divine eyes of Lord Vishnu.
